📋 **Admission Process at Galgotias University:**

1. Visit our official admission portal or campus office.
2. Fill out the online application form.
3. Submit required documents (10th & 12th marksheets, migration certificate, ID proof).
4. Pay the application registration fee.
5. Appear for counseling or merit/entrance criteria check if applicable.
6. Receive your formal admission confirmation letter.

Admission slots fill fast! Would you like to know about specific course timelines?

📌 **Eligibility Criteria Overview:**

• **UG Courses (BCA, B.Sc, B.Com, BA):** 10+2 with minimum 50% marks from a recognized board.
• **Engineering (B.Tech):** 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with minimum 50% marks.
• **MBA:** Graduation in any stream with standard qualifying marks + entrance clear scores.
• **MCA:** Graduation with Mathematics at 10+2 level or at Graduation level.

Do you want precise eligibility details for a specific program?

**Undergraduate (UG):**

• B.Tech (CSE, ECE, ME, CE, Cyber Security, AI & ML)
• B.Sc (Computer Science / IT / Applied Sciences)
• B.Com (Hons.) & BBA

**Postgraduate (PG):**
• MCA – Master of Computer Applications
• M.Tech & M.Sc Programs
